sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) || '-' || split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest, string_agg(split_part(market_ticker,'-',3) || ':' || strategy, ' ' ORDER BY market_ticker, strategy) AS legs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE strategy='Rmmsell1') AS r1_losses, count(*) FILTER (WHERE strategy='Rmmsell2') AS r2_losses, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) AS total_pnl FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Rmmsell1','Rmmsell2') AND pnl < 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
